falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the 77% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support, and losing it proves this is not a comparable bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility/early-stage panic; sustained VIX above 35 indicates systemic fear escalation inconsistent with a bottoming process and confirms we are in a different regime than August 2024

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield exceeds 2Y yield by more than 10 basis points) and holds for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Curve uninversion during risk-off conditions signals recession pricing, not soft-landing bottom; August 2024 bottom occurred with deeply inverted curve, so this divergence proves the macro backdrop is incompatible with the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
